data.name: Dilep
data.gender_notes: Dilep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dilepana', meaning 'one who loves God'. This name is associated with devotion and spiritual growth. The name Dilep carries the meaning “Lover of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilep usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with love and devotion towards the divine.
data.etymology: Dilep belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilep total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
